title: Zesty Dense Polish Yeast Dumplings
description: A traditional Polish dish featuring yeast and lardons, perfect for a midnight craving, this shojin-friendly recipe is dense and full of flavor, with a hint of grassy notes.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and salt, whisking until well combined.
Add warm water, sugar, and egg to the bowl, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 10 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Preheat a large pot of salted water to 190 degrees.
Punch down the dough and divide into 8 equal pieces, shaping each into a ball.
Add lardons to the pot and cook for 2 minutes, then add the dumplings and cook for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the pot with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess moisture.
Sprinkle parsley and black pepper over the dumplings and serve hot.
